# Drishti — Vedic Astrology

> Free online Vedic astrology tool for generating birth charts (Kundli), marriage compatibility matching (Gun Milan), and personalized readings.

## What This App Does

Drishti is a web application that generates Vedic birth charts using the Swiss Ephemeris for astronomical calculations. Users enter their birth date, time, and location to receive a complete astrological analysis.

## Features

- Birth chart with North Indian and South Indian diagrams
- 9 planetary positions (sidereal, Lahiri ayanamsa)
- 12 house cusps (Placidus system)
- 3-level Vimshottari Dasha (Mahadasha, Antardasha, Pratyantar)
- Yogini Dasha (36-year alternative system)
- 25 yoga detections
- 3 dosha detections (Manglik, Kalsarpa, Sade Sati) with remedies
- Shadbala (planetary strength)
- Ashtakavarga (transit prediction points)
- 17 divisional charts (D-1 through D-60)
- Current transits mapped to natal houses
- Daily personalized insights
- Ashtakoota Gun Milan (36-point marriage compatibility)
- PDF export for birth chart and match reports
- 12-lesson Study Mode teaching users to read charts
- FAQ with 6 categories, 18 questions
- REST API at /api/chart
- Marriage timing analysis via chatbot
- Love vs arranged marriage, foreign settlement, business vs job indicators
- Culturally neutral universal remedies alongside traditional ones
- Western zodiac comparison shown alongside Vedic signs
- Google Analytics 4 integration (optional, via GA4_ID env var)

## URLs

- Home: https://kundli-2c3b.onrender.com/
- FAQ: https://kundli-2c3b.onrender.com/faq
- API: POST https://kundli-2c3b.onrender.com/api/chart

## API

POST /api/chart with JSON body:
```json
{"date": "1996-09-23", "time": "22:17", "location": "Chandigarh, India", "tz": 5.5}
```
Returns: planets, houses, dashas, yogas, lagna as JSON.
